group.label: Connection
group.comment: Keys are in the "API keys" section of your OneTrace project. A store view can be connected to its own project.

field.label: Platform address
field.comment: The address you open the platform at, e.g. https://cdp.onetrace.pro or the domain of your brand.

field.label: Write key
field.comment: cdp_wk_… — for the tracker on the storefront.

field.label: Secret key
field.comment: cdp_sk_… with the products.write permission — for orders, customers and the catalog.

group.label: Store emails
group.comment: Order, registration and password emails of the store can go through the email integration of your OneTrace project, with delivery statuses and history in the customer profile, and order emails can be built from OneTrace templates in the customer's language. Turn them on in Store emails of the platform; the secret key needs the messages.send permission ("Send messages manually").

field.label: Tracker
field.comment: Page and product views on the storefront.

field.label: Cookie consent
field.comment: With "Cookie Restriction Mode" on, load the tracker after the visitor allows cookies.

field.label: Orders
field.comment: Placed, paid (invoiced), shipped (with the carrier and the tracking number), cancelled and refunded orders with the customer data.

field.label: Delivered order statuses
field.comment: Magento has no delivery state: an order that moves to one of these statuses is sent once as delivered (order_delivered), e.g. a "Delivered" status your shipping extension or staff set. "Complete" means invoiced and shipped, not delivered. Nothing selected — not sent.

field.label: Cart
field.comment: Adding to and removing from the cart and the wishlist, opening the checkout — for abandoned cart, price drop and back in stock journeys.

field.label: Product catalog
field.comment: Products with their stock, categories and descriptions for recommendations, emails and AI answers about products, updated when products or their stock change and daily.

field.label: Show the “Notify when available” form
field.comment: On the page of a product that cannot be bought — the form of the “Notify when available” kind from Site → Forms of the platform, drawn by the tracker; Magento's own “Notify me when this product is in stock” link is hidden then. A journey with the Catalog → “back in stock” trigger sends the notification.

field.label: Show “Ask AI about this product” on product pages
field.comment: Under “Add to cart” — the product questions widget from Site → Product questions of the platform, drawn by the tracker: the AI answers shoppers from the product description, attributes and the knowledge base of the shop. It appears only when the widget is on in OneTrace; otherwise nothing is shown. The AI is paid from the balance of the project.

field.label: Newsletter subscriptions
field.comment: Subscribing and unsubscribing in the store (registration, account, footer form) become consents in OneTrace.

field.label: Communication preferences in My Account
field.comment: My Account → Communication preferences: subscription topics by channel, frequency, a pause and unsubscribing from everything, as in the OneTrace preference center. Topics are set up in Messaging rules → Subscription topics of the platform. The secret key needs the profiles.read and profiles.write permissions.

field.label: Bonus points
field.comment: The loyalty program of the platform: signed-in customers pay for part of the order with points in the cart and at checkout and see their points in My Account → Bonus points. The secret key needs the loyalty.read and loyalty.write permissions.

field.label: Friend's code field
field.comment: The "Friend's code" field in the registration form. Without it the code of a referral link (?ref=) still counts: the tracker keeps it in a cookie, and the friend gets the welcome reward on registration.

field.label: Product search
field.comment: Search results and suggestions while typing from OneTrace: word forms, typos, the wrong keyboard layout and the visitor's interests. On any error the store search runs as usual. The plan of the project must include product search.

field.label: OneTrace search widget
field.comment: The tracker draws the search layer under the search box and the whole search results page — products, filters, sorting, endless scrolling and "Add to cart" — instead of Magento's results and layered navigation, when the search widget is on in Site → Search of the platform (checked every 10 minutes). Otherwise, and on any error, the store search page stays as it is. The plan of the project must include product search.

field.label: Subscription topic
field.comment: Empty — the whole email channel.

group.label: Recommendations and Web Push
group.comment: Widget ids are in the "Site → Widgets" section of the platform. Anywhere else add the "OneTrace recommendations" widget in Content → Widgets.

field.label: Web Push
field.comment: Serve /cdp-sw.js from the store root.

group.label: AI chat bot: store MCP
group.comment: The AI bot of the OneTrace chat answers customers with live store data — order status, tracking, stock, shipping, returns — and, if you allow it, cancels unpaid orders and passes return and delivery change requests to the staff. Customers are confirmed by the login on the storefront or by a code the store sends by email. The secret key needs the chats.manage permission; the AI chat of the project is paid from its balance.

field.label: Connect to the chat bot
field.comment: Saving connects the store to the bot of the project (Chats → Chat settings → Bot → Store MCP).

field.label: What the bot may do
field.comment: Actions run only after the customer clearly agrees in the chat; the bot cancels only orders with nothing paid.

field.label: Return policy page
field.comment: The CMS page the bot reads the return policy from.

field.label: Confirmation code email template
field.comment: An observer of the onetrace_store_mcp_send_code event can send the code itself, e.g. by SMS.

field.label: Requests to the staff
field.comment: Return and delivery change requests go to this store email address and to the order comments.

group.label: Promo codes
group.comment: Unique codes of OneTrace promo code pools become coupons of cart price rules every 5 minutes, one use each with the expiry of the code. The rule needs the "Specific Coupon" type with "Use Auto Generation".

field.label: Pools and cart price rules
field.comment: One per line: pool key = rule ID, e.g. welcome = 12. The secret key needs the promo.read permission.
